mapper.select: /* isry.drmgs.dashboard.mapper.DashboardMapper.selectChartData - HeeSung Yoon */ SELECT NVL(T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, '서비스진행') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM SEB400 T1, SEB420 T2, SAC100 T3 WHERE T1.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AND RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U03' AND T1.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD = #{LINK_TYPE_SE_CD} AND T2.RCPT_SN = (SELECT MAX(RCPT_SN) FROM SEB420 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO) AND T2.RJCT_CS_SE_CD = T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) AND 'RJCT_CS_SE_CD' = T3.CMMNS_CD_ID(+) AND T1.RQST_YMD BETWEEN #{START_DATE} AND #{END_DATE} GROUP BY T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM

/* isry.drmgs.dashboard.mapper.DashboardMapper.selectBarChartData - HeeSung Yoon */ WITH MON_T AS ( SELECT '01' AS MON FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '02' AS MON FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '03' AS MON FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '04' AS MON FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '05' AS MON FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '06' AS MON FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '07' AS MON FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '08' AS MON FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '09' AS MON FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '10' AS MON FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '11' AS MON FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '12' AS MON FROM DUAL ) , DATA_T AS ( SELECT SUBSTR(RQST_YMD, 5, 2) AS MONTH, COUNT(1) AS value FROM SEB400 T1, SEB420 T2, SAC100 T3 WHERE T1.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AND RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U03' AND T1.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD = #{LINK_TYPE_SE_CD} AND T2.RCPT_SN = (SELECT MAX(RCPT_SN) FROM SEB420 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO) AND T2.RJCT_CS_SE_CD = T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) AND 'RJCT_CS_SE_CD' = T3.CMMNS_CD_ID(+) AND T1.RQST_YMD BETWEEN #{START_DATE} AND #{END_DATE} GROUP BY SUBSTR(RQST_YMD, 5, 2) ) SELECT A.MON, B.VALUE FROM MON_T A, DATA_T B WHERE A.MON = B.MONTH(+)

SELECT T1.RQST_YMD, COUNT(1) AS TOT_CNT FROM SEB400 T1, SEB420 T2, SAC100 T3 WHERE T1.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO AND RQST_UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = 'U03' AND T1.LINK_TYPE_SE_CD = #{LINK_TYPE_SE_CD} AND T2.RCPT_SN = (SELECT MAX(RCPT_SN) FROM SEB420 WHERE SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO = T2.SRVC_PVSN_RQST_NO) AND T2.RJCT_CS_SE_CD = T3.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) AND 'RJCT_CS_SE_CD' = T3.CMMNS_CD_ID(+) GROUP BY T1.RQST_YMD
